scope: One deploy-only Azure ML command job using registered Lab 5 model version 2. No training, registration, build, new roles, or Git publication.

job.name: lab5-deploy-only-4bec26f-20261014-01
job.duration_note: Studio duration, not total time including cold start and not a billing calculation.

failure.stage: Pipeline container image pull, before the deployment command could start.
failure.portal_error: UserError: Failed to pull Docker image.
failure.portal_explanation: The compute may be unable to authenticate with the registry. The message mentions AcrPull but does not identify the principal used for the failed pull.
failure.diagnostic_logs: Downloaded default logs contained hosttools and lifecycler system logs, not user-command logs. Raw logs were kept outside the repository.
failure.http_checks_reason: The model deployment never started; staging still has its placeholder image with ingress disabled.

interpretation.likely_gap: Release is selected in the job and has no ACR role; training has AcrPull and previously completed a job with the same pipeline image.
interpretation.not_proven: The available error does not identify the image-pull principal. Missing release AcrPull is a hypothesis, not a confirmed root cause.
interpretation.earlier_assumption: The plan assumed that training, listed first on the shared compute, would handle image preparation for the release job. This failure means that assumption is not verified.
interpretation.proposed_next_step_not_applied: Review an AcrPull grant for the Lab 5 release identity only at the existing ACR scope, then one approved retry. Do not enable the ACR admin user or add unrelated roles.
interpretation.reference_limit: Microsoft documents the default compute identity for registry access; it does not identify the principal used by this failed job.

final_readback.cost_limit: Zero compute nodes does not mean zero storage, App, or shared-resource costs.

verification_limits: No deployment, runtime model loading, or HTTP smoke check was verified.
